---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest something new for PrefKeeper
labels: enhancement
---

**Before filing:** PrefKeeper deliberately covers presentation only —
color, text, motion, focus — and never touches semantic HTML, ARIA, or
alt text. See [SCOPE.md](../../docs/SCOPE.md) for the full boundary and
why it's there. If your idea falls outside that, it's likely still a
good idea — just probably not one PrefKeeper itself should implement.

**What problem does this solve?**
What are you trying to do that isn't currently possible?

**What you'd like to see**
A clear description of the feature or change.

**Alternatives considered**
Any other ways you've thought about solving this, if any.
